applicability: Family realization-detail and recorded member-context presentation over bounded or unavailable family roster context.
conditions: Loaded member contexts and loaded source claims are distinguished from the read owner cumulative item counts.
A recorded side is fully loaded only when its page is complete, its measured membership population is present and member content is recorded.
Partial or unavailable context states its limit and retains any owner-published continuation.
exclusions: Inferring absent stored attribution or unchanged unreturned expressions from an empty loaded set.
Semantic acceptance, whole-source inventory filtering, or replacement of source/evidence owners.
statement: Partial family realization and member-context views state that the roster is not fully loaded and retain user-driven owner-published continuation; loaded member counts remain distinct from the read owner's cumulative item counts.
